description: Source code for operator registration in PyTorch, including functions for schema inference, duplicate kernel checks, and operator registration.

classes.name: RegisterOperators
classes.description: Class responsible for registering operators, managing schemas, kernels, and ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: checkSchemaAndRegisterOp_
methods.description: Checks operator schema and registers the operator with provided options.

methods.name: inferSchemaFromKernels_
methods.description: Infers operator schema from provided kernels if explicit schema is not given.

methods.name: checkNoDuplicateKernels_
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate kernels are registered for the same dispatch key or catch-all.

methods.name: registerOp_
methods.description: Performs the actual registration of the operator schema and kernels.
